item: Seed flip-flop closed: the default and legal seeds no longer correct each other, and the seven news feeds they erased come back
refs: R152; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: Measured by the Q thread on a fresh store: every boot applied 56 and 55 'corrections' in two directions, and the legal seed's feed-less entry erased rss_url for asean.org, au.int, congress.gov, gov.uk, icc-cpi.int, icj-cij.org and oas.org (and region for five) on the FIRST boot, so those sources stopped being collected. Two causes, two fixes: seed_default_sources builds the legal rows with the same registration_source_rows the legal seed uses, and sync_catalogue_corrections skips an entry of another catalogue than the row's own via: tag (counted as foreign_catalogue); the name-pairing fallback applies the same rule. R152 repair: repair_erased_feeds restores rss_url and region only where the row's own catalogue has the value, the live value is empty and the baseline is the record of a feed-less entry of another catalogue; a feed the operator cleared is never refilled (counted), anything unprovable is listed as not restored. Run against the real catalogues with the seven erased, it restored all seven and the next sync returned the swapped names. A seed merge that only records offered tags is now committed (get_db callers never commit). The default seed's own list grows by 205 generated legal rows (the legal seed registered them a moment later anyway): boot rows 6,616, merged 245, unregistered 33.
